---
title: Roman Bruschetta
id: MAR-0020
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 20
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 4 slices of country bread
- 2 ramati tomato
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 teaspoon of capers in salt
- 4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Desalt the capers and chop them coarsely.
2. Wash and dice the tomatoes, removing the vegetable water, place them in a bowl, add the capers, season with salt and pepper, and dress with 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil.
3. Toast the bread slices in the oven at 200 °C for 5 minutes, turning them once.
4. Rub one side of the bread slices with the peeled garlic and brush them with the remaining oil.
5. Arrange the tomatoes on top and serve.
